reason: Verified by measurement, not reading. Drove master.html in chromium across all fourteen states at 390/768/1152/1279/1280/1440 and read computed letter-spacing on every visible element with its own text. Findings match the claim: .b-num renders 148px at -0.04em (-5.92px) in six state renders (owner-flight, owner-editing, owner-undone, owner-draft, desk, print) at every width from 768 up, and 96px at the SAME -0.04em on the phone frame and at 390 - so the em fit does not move while the size grows 54%, and the absolute gap grows with it, which is the reverse of what optical letterfit asks. .b-emptyTitle at 64px and .b-pressTitle at 48px both render -0.035em (--track-title, whose own comment says 'sans 48px'), i.e. two title-tier sizes on one letterfit - the exact condition round 6 confirmed. Token-use tally across the whole matrix: --track-display-148, --track-title-64, --track-title-48 and --track-display each match ZERO rendered elements; only --track-display-96, --track-display-64 and --track-dayCount's step landed. So three of the five graded steps declared by round 6's own fix were never applied, and the pre-grade token was orphaned beside them. The gate-blindness explanation is correct and is what makes this a finding rather than a restatement, and I confirmed it in audit.mjs: the role check keys tracking on family|size|role (audit.mjs:343) and merges across states, so mono|148|display and mono|96|display are separate keys each with one occupant, and Geist|64|headline and Geist|48|headline likewise (both titles carry data-type="headline", render-b.js:1450 and 1630) - a check keyed on size can never see 'two sizes, one em'. The ladder check (audit.mjs:315) only asks whether the rendered value equals SOME declared --track-* times the size, and -0.04em and -0.035em are declared, so both pass; worse, because ladder() harvests every --track-* off any rule, the three dead distinct values (-0.045, -0.05, -0.038) are admitted anywhere in the artifact, so the round-6 tokens currently widen the ladder they were written to tighten. Not taste: the argument is the file's own declared grade plus the visible result - rendering the count at -0.05em closes 'the largest object in the composition' from 165.77px to 162.81px, a 2.96px close on two gaps, and the crop comparison shows the 7/9 pair visibly tucking. Not already handled, no constraint touched (no colour, no weight, no architecture), and the fix invents nothing: every value is already declared and ratified. I also checked the fix does not break either gate: after it, mono|148|display holds only -0.05em, Geist|64|headline only -0.038em, Geist|48|headline only -0.032em (no other element renders sans 64 or 48 with data-type="headline"), all three values are on the ladder, and nothing anywhere renders at -0.045em, so deleting --track-display orphans nothing. One correction to the finding's prose: the 148px count appears in four owner states plus desk plus print - six renders, not 'six owner states, plus desk, plus print' - and --track-title-48's value (-0.032em) is not itself dead, since --track-display-64 already carries it; the three genuinely dead distinct values are -0.045, -0.05 and -0.038. Neither wobble touches the substance.
sharpenedFix: Four one-line edits, every value already declared. (1) b.css:1293 - `[data-medium="sheet"] .b-num, [data-medium="full"] .b-num { font-size: var(--size-countWide); }` becomes `{ font-size: var(--size-countWide); letter-spacing: var(--track-display-148); }`, so the hero count stops wearing the phone step at desk and print width. (2) b.css:1313 - `letter-spacing: var(--track-title)` becomes `var(--track-title-64)`. (3) b.css:1316 - `letter-spacing: var(--track-title)` becomes `var(--track-title-48)`. (4) shell.css:61 - delete `--track-display: -0.045em;` and its now-superseded comment; nothing references it and nothing renders at that value, so removing it narrows the ladder-membership test back to steps the design actually intends. After (2) and (3) the name --track-title has no remaining reference; either delete it too or keep it only if a 48px sans title outside the headline role is planned - do not leave a fifth dead token behind while removing a fourth. Verify with audit.mjs: tracking and trackingLadder must both stay empty across all fourteen states.
